name: example/sqlmigrations-php-laravel-scaffold
description: Runnable scaffold: human-owned SQL migrations (Phinx) -> typed PHP DB schema (@phpstan-type) with Principle IV enforcement.

scripts-descriptions.generate-db-types: Start a throwaway Postgres, run the Phinx SQL migrations, introspect the real schema, emit .generated/schema.php.
scripts-descriptions.verify-schema: Pin the engine, assert generation happened, and fail on any unmapped column type.
